China has a trade surplus exceeding $1 trillion. This is the second year in a row it has crossed this staggering milestone. In fact, China recorded a trade surplus of $1.04 trillion in just the first ten months of 2026. While the world buys more Chinese goods, China's own economy struggles with weak consumer demand and a property market slowdown. Samah Qundeel explains what's driving this boom and why it is important.
